contract_owner.role: read-only source, convention, domain, theorem-interface, and claim-ceiling framing

source_identity.optical_binding: OPTICAL_THEOREMS.md lines 58-90 for algebraic coefficients and lines 263-268, equation (27), for the two arbitrary-shear first-order inverse expressions

conventions.rest_tensor: B_rest=diag(0,D), D real symmetric 3x3 in rate units
conventions.boost_branch: positive nonnegative real square-root branch in imported gamma
conventions.dipole_sign: dipoleMap D beta i = -2 * boostedB D beta none (some i)
conventions.norm: imported Euclidean eNorm and induced Euclidean opNorm only

definitions: outer v w i j := v i * w j
spatialBlock D beta i j := boostedB D beta (some i) (some j)
timeCoefficient D beta := boostedB D beta none none
monopoleCoefficient D beta := timeCoefficient D beta + trace(spatialBlock D beta)/3
quadrupoleCoefficient D beta := spatialBlock D beta - (trace(spatialBlock D beta)/3) • I
coefficientMatrix D beta := monopoleCoefficient D beta • I + quadrupoleCoefficient D beta
exact_lean_target_signatures: theorem coefficientMatrix_eq (D : M3) (beta : V3) : coefficientMatrix D beta = timeCoefficient D beta • (1 : M3) + spatialBlock D beta
theorem quadrupoleCoefficient_trace (D : M3) (beta : V3) : (quadrupoleCoefficient D beta).trace = 0
theorem quadrupoleCoefficient_symmetric (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) : ∀ i j, quadrupoleCoefficient D beta i j = quadrupoleCoefficient D beta j i

theorem algebraic_sky_expansion (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (beta n : V3) (hn : q n = 1) : dotProduct (observerNull n) ((boostedB D beta).mulVec (observerNull n)) = monopoleCoefficient D beta + dot3 (dipoleMap D beta) n + dot3 n ((quadrupoleCoefficient D beta).mulVec n)
theorem coefficientMatrix_zero (D : M3) : coefficientMatrix D 0 = D

theorem coefficientMatrix_perturbation_exact (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) : coefficientMatrix D beta - D = (gamma beta ^ 2 * sourceQuadratic D beta) • (1 : M3) + boostA beta • (outer beta (D.mulVec beta) + outer (D.mulVec beta) beta) + (boostA beta ^ 2 * sourceQuadratic D beta) • outer beta beta

theorem coefficientMatrix_perturbation_norm_pointwise (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : opNorm (coefficientMatrix D beta - D) ≤ (2 * opNorm D / (1 - q beta)) * eNorm beta ^ 2

theorem coefficientMatrix_perturbation_norm_ball (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) (r : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hbeta : eNorm beta ≤ r) : opNorm (coefficientMatrix D beta - D) ≤ (2 * opNorm D / (1 - r ^ 2)) * eNorm beta ^ 2
accepted_supporting_lemma_signatures: theorem timeCoefficient_exact (D : M3) (beta : V3) : timeCoefficient D beta = gamma beta ^ 2 * sourceQuadratic D beta
theorem outer_mulVec (v w x : V3) : (outer v w).mulVec x = (dot3 w x) • v
theorem opNorm_le_of_mulVec_bound (M : M3) (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (h : ∀ v : V3, eNorm (M.mulVec v) ≤ k * eNorm v) : opNorm M ≤ k
theorem spatialBlock_mulVec_beta (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : (spatialBlock D beta).mulVec beta = (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) • dipoleMap D beta

theorem coefficientMatrix_mulVec_beta (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : (coefficientMatrix D beta).mulVec beta = (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) • dipoleMap D beta + timeCoefficient D beta • beta

proof_constant.derivation: gamma^2*q + 2*boostA*q + boostA^2*q^2 = 2*gamma^2*q, using boostA*q=gamma-1 and gamma^2*(1-q)=1
